TARGET CITIES (HIGH): Mohali, Chandigarh, Ludhiana, Delhi NCR, Amritsar. BRAND VOICE: Warm, professional, confident. No exclamation spam. Max 1 emoji. Sign-off: Team Chicking Mohali", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": ('Score this franchise lead. Return ONLY valid JSON: {score:0-100,tier:HOT/WARM/COLD,reasoning:one sentence,priority_action:next step for Ajay}

'+ 'City: ' + ($json.body.city || $json.city || 'unknown') + '
'+ 'Investment: ' + ($json.body.investment || $json.investment || 'not stated') + '
'+ 'Background: ' + ($json.body.background || $json.background || 'not stated') + '
'+ 'Property: ' + ($json.body.property || $json.property || 'not stated') + '
'+ 'Experience: ' + ($json.body.experience || $json.experience || 'not stated'))}]}) }}

={{ ({"model": "claude-haiku-4-5", "max_tokens": 120, "temperature": 0.1, "system": "You are a strict brand compliance auditor for Chicking Mohali. AUTO-FAIL on ANY: halal reference; any payback/ROI/returns/EBITDA/earnings/profit figure or promise; guaranteed or fixed returns; a specific franchise fee/cost stated as a brand claim (the only allowed franchise-investment phrasing is 'Rs60 Lakhs+'); first/only-in-North-India claim; unconfirmed opening date; more than 1 exclamation mark; more than 1 emoji. ={{ ({ filterGroups: [{ filters: [{ propertyName: "phone", operator: "CONTAINS_TOKEN", value: ($('Parse Score').first().json.lead_phone || '') }] }].concat( ($('Score Trigger').first().json.body && $('Score Trigger').first().json.body.email) ?
